label: Botulism Sequelae: A Systematic Review.
summary: Botulism is a life-threatening neuroparalytic disease caused by botulinum neurotoxins. While its acute phase has been extensively studied, long-term sequelae following recovery remain insufficiently explored. This systematic review aims to comprehensively assess and synthesize available evidence on post-botulism sequelae to improve understanding and guide future research.
